subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

She left the party ______ because of her parents' strict time restrictions. [late]
solution:
The correct answer is: **early**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"late"** means after the expected or usual time; it can refer to something that happens or is done after the scheduled time. (देर से)

 
 
• **Example: **She arrived late to the meeting because of the traffic.
 
 
 
• **"Early" **refers to something that happens before the expected or usual time; it is the opposite of late. (जल्दी)
 
 
• **Example: **She arrived early to the meeting to prepare her presentation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'late' **is **'early'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **early**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exit **(निकास): A way out of a building, room, or vehicle.

 
 
• **Example:** The emergency exit is located at the back of the room.
 
 
 
• **Small **(छोटा): Of a size that is less than normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a small apartment in the city.
 
 
 
• **Suffer** (सहन करना): To experience pain, distress, or hardship.
 
 
• **Example:** He continues to suffer from chronic back pain.
